elements.text: The Faculty of Sciences at the University of Agriculture Faisalabad (UAF) has been a cornerstone of scientific education and research since its establishment in 1974, evolving from the former Basic Sciences and Arts division following the introduction of the new education policy. Currently the 2nd largest faculty at the University, it comprises eight departments and offers a diverse range of programs across the scientific disciplines.The Faculty of Sciences is committed to providing quality education at all levels. At the main campus, we offer MS degrees in Software Engineering, Computer Science and Bioinformatics, and MPhil degrees in Biochemistry, Botany, Chemistry, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Zoology, and Wildlife & Fisheries. Our PhD programs at the main campus cover a wide spectrum of specializations, including Biochemistry, Botany, Chemistry, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Zoology, Wildlife and Fisheries. Recognizing the need for accessible education, the Faculty also extends its MPhil programs to constituent colleges at PARS, Toba Tek Singh, Burewala-Vihari and Depalpur (Okara), with specializations in Botany, Chemistry, Physics and Zoology. Furthermore, the Faculty of Sciences offers comprehensive BS programs designed to equip students with strong foundational knowledge and practical skills in pioneering and emerging fields such as Botany, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, Zoology, Fisheries, Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Bioinformatics, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence.Our faculty is dedicated to advancing the frontiers of knowledge through state-of-the-art laboratories and cutting-edge research. Research within the Faculty spans a wide array of specializations, tackling key challenges and contributing to both national and international scientific communities. The faculty has secured numerous research grants from various funding agencies, enabling our researchers to pursue innovative projects and generate a substantial number of publications in high-impact journals.Beyond academics, the Faculty of Sciences recognizes the importance of holistic development. We actively promote co-curricular and extracurricular activities, providing students with opportunities to enhance their skills, engage in sports, participate in cultural events, and develop leadership qualities. These activities foster a vibrant campus community and contribute to the overall educational experience.

elements.richHtml:
The Faculty of Sciences at the University of Agriculture Faisalabad (UAF) has been a cornerstone of scientific education and research since its establishment in 1974, evolving from the former Basic Sciences and Arts division following the introduction of the new education policy. Currently the 2nd largest faculty at the University, it comprises eight departments and offers a diverse range of programs across the scientific disciplines.

The Faculty of Sciences is committed to providing quality education at all levels. At the main campus, we offer MS degrees in Software Engineering, Computer Science and Bioinformatics, and MPhil degrees in Biochemistry, Botany, Chemistry, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Zoology, and Wildlife & Fisheries. Our PhD programs at the main campus cover a wide spectrum of specializations, including Biochemistry, Botany, Chemistry, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Zoology, Wildlife and Fisheries. Recognizing the need for accessible education, the Faculty also extends its MPhil programs to constituent colleges at PARS, Toba Tek Singh, Burewala-Vihari and Depalpur (Okara), with specializations in Botany, Chemistry, Physics and Zoology. Furthermore, the Faculty of Sciences offers comprehensive BS programs designed to equip students with strong foundational knowledge and practical skills in pioneering and emerging fields such as Botany, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, Zoology, Fisheries, Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Bioinformatics, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence.

Our faculty is dedicated to advancing the frontiers of knowledge through state-of-the-art laboratories and cutting-edge research. Research within the Faculty spans a wide array of specializations, tackling key challenges and contributing to both national and international scientific communities. The faculty has secured numerous research grants from various funding agencies, enabling our researchers to pursue innovative projects and generate a substantial number of publications in high-impact journals.

Beyond academics, the Faculty of Sciences recognizes the importance of holistic development. We actively promote co-curricular and extracurricular activities, providing students with opportunities to enhance their skills, engage in sports, participate in cultural events, and develop leadership qualities. These activities foster a vibrant campus community and contribute to the overall educational experience.

elements.text: The Department of Agronomy was established with the inception of the Punjab Agricultural College and Research Institute, Lyallpur in 1906. As one of the foundational academic pillars, it has led human resource development and high-yielding crop production packages that catalyzed the Green Revolution in Pakistan.
Up till today, the Department has produced over 3,200 B.Sc. (Hons), 2,800 M.Sc. (Hons) and 180 Ph.D. scholars serving in multinational agribusinesses and research institutions.

elements.text: The Faculty of Health and Pharmaceutical Sciences at UAF plays a quintessential role in advancing healthcare through demand-driven research, innovation, teaching, skill development, capacity building, and community service. Aligned with UN SDG #3 (Good Health and Well-being) and WHO International Health Regulations (IHR), the faculty is committed to achieving targets for universal healthcare provision, policy development, and international collaborations. A primary strategic objective is reducing the national import bill by fostering indigenous solutions for pharmaceutical production and commercialization to contribute direcly to Pakistan's knowledge-based economy.

elements.text: The Faculty of Animal Husbandry is a pioneer institution that imparts Animal Husbandry education, mandated to genetically improve livestock and poultry species to enhance productivity and bring prosperity to farmers and the nation. It offers three 4-year undergraduate degree programs—BS Animal Sciences, BS Dairy Science, and BS Poultry Science—as well as a 2-year B.Sc. (Hons) Animal Sciences program after agri-Sciences. Across these undergraduate programs, over 500 students are currently enrolled. The faculty also offers 8 postgraduate degree programs (4 Master's and 4 PhD programs corresponding to its key disciplines) with over 125 enrolled students, including 12 PhD scholars. To support student learning, the faculty offers 39 undergraduate courses, 62 postgraduate courses, and several short courses. A sub-center of the "National Center of Livestock Breeding, Genetics and Genomics" has been established to implement genomics and provide hands-on training in molecular and computational skills. Additionally, faculty members have published over 60 books and completed numerous research projects published in reputable impact factor journals.

elements.text: An important part of our educational mission is to provide veterinary students with fine introduction to basic morphologic concepts in domestic animals at macroscopic, microscopic and molecular levels, emphasizing structural and functional relationships. A second major goal of the educational mission is the training of graduate students for biomedical career in teaching, research and industry and indirectly creating new knowledge. Techniques used in our laboratories include immunohistochemistry, transmission and scanning electron microscopy, ultrasonography, cell and tissue culture and automated image analysis.We appreciate your interest in our department. Please visit our web site or contact us if you have any questions or if you need additional information.

elements.richHtml:
An important part of our educational mission is to provide veterinary students with fine introduction to basic morphologic concepts in domestic animals at macroscopic, microscopic and molecular levels, emphasizing structural and functional relationships. A second major goal of the educational mission is the training of graduate students for biomedical career in teaching, research and industry and indirectly creating new knowledge. Techniques used in our laboratories include immunohistochemistry, transmission and scanning electron microscopy, ultrasonography, cell and tissue culture and automated image analysis.
We appreciate your interest in our department. Please visit our web site or contact us if you have any questions or if you need additional information.
